artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the spine ('...CIO') is partially legible but distorted. The script on the front cover resembles handwriting but dissolves into nonsensical shapes and illegible characters upon close inspection, a classic AI generation artifact where text structure is mimicked but semantic content is missing.

The line drawings on the cover lack consistent stroke width and sharpness. Some lines fade into the background texture without clear boundaries, suggesting slight 'melting' or diffusion artifacts typical of generative models struggling with fine linear details on textured surfaces.
